description: This Java source file implements a REST API resource class 'NotesApiResource' for managing notes linked to various resource types in a Fineract-based financial application. It provides endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting notes associated with resources such as clients, loans, loan transactions, savings accounts, and groups. The class utilizes JAX-RS annotations for routing, Swagger annotations for documentation, and interacts with service layers for data access and command processing.

classes.name: NotesApiResource
classes.description: Controller class providing REST endpoints for managing notes related to various resource types such as clients, loans, and groups in a Fineract-based system.

methods.name: retrieveNotesByResource
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all notes for a specific resource type and resource ID, validating resource type and permissions.

methods.name: retrieveNote
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific note by note ID, resource type, and resource ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: addNewNote
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note attached to a resource, serializing note data to JSON.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note identified by note ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific note.

methods.name: getResourceDetails
methods.description: Helper method to build command wrapper with resource identifiers based on note type.
